## Diagnosis

In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, the `wrap_bare_frontmatter` helper converts bare front matter into the fenced form so the downstream parser can extract metadata. Before assembling the fences, it filtered the header lines:

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

This silently dropped every indented YAML continuation line. For:

```yaml
title: Foo
depends:
  - foo
```

the `  - foo` line was discarded, leaving `depends:` as a null scalar. `serde_yaml::Value::get("depends")` then returned `Null`, so `metadata_matches` couldn't match `foo` (or anything). Fenced (`---`) front matter skipped that wrapper entirely, so it worked. Existing tests only used scalar values in bare front matter, so nothing caught it.

## Fix

`crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs` — preserve all header lines verbatim when wrapping bare front matter (indented lines are valid YAML: list items, nested mappings, multiline scalars).

## Regression test

`crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs::bare_frontmatter_sequence_value_matches` — replicates the user's exact `iwe find --meta depends=foo` scenario against a bare-frontmatter doc with a YAML sequence. Fails before the fix, passes after.

Full `cargo test` suite is green.
